hero.title: Axopar 37 XC Cross Cabin
hero.heading: Axopar 37 XC Cross Cabin – Adventure on Your Own Terms
hero.subheading: THE ALL-WEATHER PERFORMER THE ULTIMATE CROSSOVER BETWEEN OPEN AND ENCLOSED BOATING
hero.intro:
The new Crossover that challenges convention in both looks and onboard functionality bringing a new era to all-weather boating.

This model combines the functionality, ease of movement, social outdoor and indoor spaces and versatility of outboard walkaround centre-consoles with a spacious, fully enclosed weather proofed cabin, that with distinctive looks challenges traditional perceptions of cabin boats.

We consider the 37XC to be the Gran Turismo of the seas opening a world of possibilities for safe, extended voyages in comfort even in unpredictable weather.

sections.title: The Market Leader Revolutionized
sections.intro: The versatile Axopar 37 with its distinctive and instantly recognisable looks is the perfect partner for all adventures at sea. It provides responsive, thrilling and sporty handling that will safely take you anywhere in supreme comfort and style. Featuring intuitive solutions, enhanced driving dynamics, flexible accommodation, and an optimized space experience.

sections.title: Driver in Focus
sections.intro: New intuitive solutions that bring the driving experience even closer to the ease and simplicity of driving a car. Redefined ergonomics contribute to a supremely practical, functional layout with excellent all-around visibility. The driver-focused helm, with its clean, uncluttered dashboard, ensures the skipper always remains in full control.

sections.title: The Gullwing Door Concept
sections.intro: The Gullwing Doors redefines how an enclosed front cabin can be best utilised to provide a more sociable feeling and full interaction with one’s surroundings, making the front cabin feel like it's part of the outdoors. Now it is possible to fully interact with and appreciate the outside surroundings like never before

sections.title: Significant Performance Gains
sections.intro: Up to 30% better fuel-economy across the 20 to 40 knot speed range, compared to the predecessor. Resulting in an extended cruising range, on average with 35% or +75 additional nautical miles. Up to +35% increase in ‘comfortable’ and most efficient cruising speed at steady 3500rpm, up from 22knots to 29 knots

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.name: For Sociable Moments
items.title: For Sociable Moments
items.text: A light, airy and comfortable pilothouse with easy access thanks to wide sliding doors on both sides. A perfect place to socialize and entertain guests is by the L-shaped sofa and table in the rear.

items.name: Built-in Electric Toilet
items.title: Built-in Electric Toilet
items.text: The built-in electric flush toilet with an 70l septic tank is easily accessible under the L-sofa in front cabin.

items.name: Multipurpose Pilothouse
items.title: Multipurpose Pilothouse
items.text: Open up the large sliding canvas roof for sunshine and fresh air, or when the weather throws a surprise close it up for full-weather protection. The large sliding canvas roof really combines the best of open and enclosed boating.

items.name: Panorama View
items.title: Panorama View
items.text: Large windscreen and side windows provide excellent all-around visibility and give full panoramic views when enjoying memorable moments inside the cosy cabin.

items.name: Spacious Fore Deck
items.title: Spacious Fore Deck
items.text: The spacious foredeck is perfect for an early-morning coffee in the sun and a great place to sit back and enjoy sunny days.  A large anchor box in the bow will hold the anchor, fenders, and ropes easily, as well as other equipment you need for your journey.

items.name: Additional Overnight Possibilities
items.title: Additional Overnight Possibilities
items.text: By sliding the mid-section of the sofa upwards, you can easily access the spacious optional aft cabin that comfortably sleeps two persons.

items.name: U-Sofa
items.title: U-Sofa
items.text: Every foot on board is used for socializing and practical living, infused with a myriad range of new onboard solutions and functions. The optional U-Sofa on the aft deck can be used as a dining space and converted into a sunbed. With storage underneath, of course.

items.name: Fixed Sunbed on Foredeck
items.title: Fixed Sunbed on Foredeck
items.text: Wide sun bed mattress and backrest in Silvertex fabric with diamond pattern stitching for foredeck. Openable and lockable storage box under sunbed in GRP. Including a harbor cover for a sun bed.

items.name: Driver experience
items.title: Driver experience
items.text: A clean and uncluttered helm station creates a driving sensation similar to the feel and simplicity of driving a car. Steering console can be equipped with an optional Glass Bridge/Information Display touch screens.

items.name: Axopar Connect
items.title: Axopar Connect
items.text: Our Axopar Connect app brings smarter, more personal boating to life. With remote access to your boat's systems, real-time safety alerts, and customizable settings, the app transforms how you interact with your vessel. The intuitive user interface, on Simrad's multifunction displays, offers seamless control over navigation, diagnostics, and entertainment.

items.caption: GET INTO GEAR ON THE HIGH COAST TRAILS
If your adventures include a lot of socializing and lounging, the U-Sofa aft configuration, which serves as both a dining spot and a lounging spot, is your option.
The renewed front cabin now has new materials and colors, which make the space even lighter than before.
Every foot on board is used for socializing and practical living, infused with a myriad range of new onboard solutions and functions.
The large sliding canvas roof, together with the two large sliding doors, really opens up the cabin to the elements on days when the weather allows.

Forget the old prejudice that a cabin boat is all just about spending time inside; the 37 XC raises the outer spaces to equal importance and functionality, as sociable and practical as it is comfortable inside.

items.title: The Iconic Edition
modal_text:
The Iconic Edition features the ever-so-popular BRABUS Line, offering refined interior and exterior styling enhancements with subtle yet distinctive design details.

The Iconic Edition features the familiar, beloved BRABUS Line colors: Miami Blue and Platinum Grey. Additionally, we are spicing things up with two new colors, familiar from the BRABUS Marine lineup: Glacier Blue and Icon Grey.

Show your personality by choosing your favorites among Silvertex Petrol with Seine PE Steel accents, Silvertex Sandstone with Seine PE Taupe accents, Silvertex Cobre with Seine PE Ochre accents, or Silvertex Baltic with Seine PE Navy accents to match your adventure spirit.

We're sweetening the deal with the widely popular Roof Racks in black and the Electric Sliding Roof to make it even easier for you to

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: Axopar 37 XC Cross Cabin BRABUS Performance Line Mediterrana Edition

The BRABUS Performance Line is a thrilling extension to the BRABUS Line that boosts the performance and enhances the boat’s appearance with a stylish hull & roof wrap. The BRABUS Performance Line includes stylish hull and roof graphics and extra power on the transom with Twin Mercury Verado V10 400hp to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text: Inspired by a laid-back Mediterranean spirit, and a love for lounging and socialising onboard, we have developed the Mediterrana Edition for the Axopar 37 range. We have now fully utilized the perfect layout of the Axopar 37s, further enhancing its appearance with a more relaxed, elegant look and greater on-board comfort.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 37 XC Cross Cabin comes with a spacious open aft deck as standard. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Aft Deck Bench, Wet Bar, U-sofa, or an Aft Cabin.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior and interior layouts available.
